_README: Facts a LatCH checkpoint does not carry. scripts/latch/train_latch.py saves feature_name but NOT --target-source / --chroma-dir / --chroma-key, so for heads trained before 2026-08-24 the chroma readout is unrecoverable from the file. Fill 'readout' here only from a training log or run script you actually read; leave it out rather than guess. 'readout' values seen in train_latch.py are the --chroma-key choices: other / bass / full_mix; a 12-d head is an HPCP readout, not a SAME-chroma one.

same_chroma.note: 3-band SAME chroma, octave centres 1/5/9, 128 bins each. Cosine loss, unstandardised. Needs a 384-d target, not a scalar.

chroma_other.source: eval/chroma_morph_transitions.py:12 — "PROVEN stem-chroma LatCH head (latch_sa3_chroma_other_best, cosine, gain 2048)"; the '_other' in the filename is train_latch.py's --chroma-key choice (other | bass | full_mix).
chroma_other.note: 384-d, cosine, gain 2048 (NOT the 512 the medium heads use). Lives on the Mantu eval drive, so it disappears from /info whenever that drive is unmounted.
